LI1 — Explicit unramified lifting and exact completion comparison
Historical/component status: derived_simplification
Statement: For an unramified number-field prime P over p of residue degree m, construct a Good embedding into Q_m=Frac(W(F_(p^m))). Conversely, every such Good embedding identifies the actual completion with Q_m and its integer ring with W_m, compatibly with the original number field.
Assumptions: ["The host is supplied: E/Q is Galois CM with its stated abelian Galois group, conjugation, complex embedding, conductor and arithmetic Frobenius law. This component does not construct the host or prove abundance of suitable primes.", "Classical background is stated in report.txt: finite fields; the Witt rings and Teichmuller expansions already used in BC1; number-field integer rings finite over Z and Dedekind; DVR localization/completion; lying over; and the elementary inertia identity |I_P|=e_P.", "BC1-BC3 are prior proved results supplying the actual finite coefficient extension, its chosen-place embedding and the exact ramification scaling. Their proofs are reused, not reasserted as new LI claims.", "All local lattices and levels are the literal supplied ColLevel/LevelData objects. A frame for each completion does not by itself construct a common global matrix B.", "The global class-rank equality and comparison-lattice identification remain separate. No full IsLocalFamily, GroupCompatibilityAll, linked family, RH or GRH conclusion is asserted here.", "For the forward direction the prime is unramified; for the converse the three literal Good clauses are given. The converse itself implies unramifiedness."]

LI2 — Frobenius fixes the exact residue degree and classifies all E-primes
Historical/component status: faithful_translation
Statement: Under the supplied arithmetic Frobenius f=((-1,-1),h) with even n=ord(h)>=2, every E-prime above p has residue degree n. For a fixed Good i:E->Q_n, P_g=ker(residue of i sigma_g) satisfies P_g'=P_g iff g'=g f^s, and every prime above p occurs.
Assumptions: ["The host is supplied: E/Q is Galois CM with its stated abelian Galois group, conjugation, complex embedding, conductor and arithmetic Frobenius law. This component does not construct the host or prove abundance of suitable primes.", "Classical background is stated in report.txt: finite fields; the Witt rings and Teichmuller expansions already used in BC1; number-field integer rings finite over Z and Dedekind; DVR localization/completion; lying over; and the elementary inertia identity |I_P|=e_P.", "BC1-BC3 are prior proved results supplying the actual finite coefficient extension, its chosen-place embedding and the exact ramification scaling. Their proofs are reused, not reasserted as new LI claims.", "All local lattices and levels are the literal supplied ColLevel/LevelData objects. A frame for each completion does not by itself construct a common global matrix B.", "The global class-rank equality and comparison-lattice identification remain separate. No full IsLocalFamily, GroupCompatibilityAll, linked family, RH or GRH conclusion is asserted here."]
Depends on: ["LI1"]

LI3 — The literal Frobenius orbits label every real-subfield prime above p
Historical/component status: derived_simplification
Statement: With c=((-1,-1),1), z=((1,1),h), Psi={(epsilon,1,a)}, n even implies c notin <f>. Every restriction i sigma_g|F is Good with residue degree n, and Psi/<z> is bijective with all primes v|p of F, using the literal orbRep/posG section and positions a_v z^s. Thus Q_n is exactly each F_v and E/F splits there.
Assumptions: ["The host is supplied: E/Q is Galois CM with its stated abelian Galois group, conjugation, complex embedding, conductor and arithmetic Frobenius law. This component does not construct the host or prove abundance of suitable primes.", "Classical background is stated in report.txt: finite fields; the Witt rings and Teichmuller expansions already used in BC1; number-field integer rings finite over Z and Dedekind; DVR localization/completion; lying over; and the elementary inertia identity |I_P|=e_P.", "BC1-BC3 are prior proved results supplying the actual finite coefficient extension, its chosen-place embedding and the exact ramification scaling. Their proofs are reused, not reasserted as new LI claims.", "All local lattices and levels are the literal supplied ColLevel/LevelData objects. A frame for each completion does not by itself construct a common global matrix B.", "The global class-rank equality and comparison-lattice identification remain separate. No full IsLocalFamily, GroupCompatibilityAll, linked family, RH or GRH conclusion is asserted here."]
Depends on: ["LI1", "LI2"]
Source relation: CRT produces b+c(b) with every required residue, without division by 2. The norm y c(y) and the two-ideal union argument prove equality of contractions directly. The target is ALL primes above p, and the source section is retained exactly.

LI5 — Explicit quadratic splitting and the frame for the actual localized lattice
Historical/component status: derived_simplification
Statement: For j:E->F_v obtained from the Good embedding, Phi(x tensor t)=(j(x)t,j(c(x))t) is the required splitting with explicit inverse. The first projection of the literal locL is exactly O_v-span(j(Lc.Lb)), a full finite-free O_v lattice. Its basis supplies fr_lat, so all fields of LocId are constructed and its recovered iw is i_v.

LI8 — Construct the actual integral inverse away character and identify the remaining global joins
Historical/component status: faithful_translation
Statement: Under literal Joint0 and LevelZeroCharacterRational, canonical finite-adelic truncation K sets components above p to one and preserves all others. Level-zero additive-character values and their inverses are algebraic integers. Their unique coefficient-field lifts map to units of ORec; psi(a)=embRec(r(K(a)))^(-1) is a homomorphism satisfying every quantifier in PsiTied. These choices are simultaneous with LI7, whose posOK holds for every psi.
Assumptions: ["The host is supplied: E/Q is Galois CM with its stated abelian Galois group, conjugation, complex embedding, conductor and arithmetic Frobenius law. This component does not construct the host or prove abundance of suitable primes.", "Classical background is stated in report.txt: finite fields; the Witt rings and Teichmuller expansions already used in BC1; number-field integer rings finite over Z and Dedekind; DVR localization/completion; lying over; and the elementary inertia identity |I_P|=e_P.", "BC1-BC3 are prior proved results supplying the actual finite coefficient extension, its chosen-place embedding and the exact ramification scaling. Their proofs are reused, not reasserted as new LI claims.", "All local lattices and levels are the literal supplied ColLevel/LevelData objects. A frame for each completion does not by itself construct a common global matrix B.", "The global class-rank equality and comparison-lattice identification remain separate. No full IsLocalFamily, GroupCompatibilityAll, linked family, RH or GRH conclusion is asserted here.", "Joint0 and LevelZeroCharacterRational are supplied; their construction from global automorphic data is not proved by the finite-character argument."]
Depends on: ["BC2", "LI7"]
Source relation: Truncation uniqueness proves multiplicativity and the universal kappa quantifier. Integrality is strengthened to unit membership by also applying the argument to inverses. The consumer references record precise remaining premises and are not counted as discharged assertions.
